issues.finding: The proposition omits the identification C=A when the succedent is the singleton {A}; the proof then names an undefined G2ci system and places the induction-hypothesis proofs in N2c instead of the stated N2i target.
issues.proposed_resolution: Identify C with the sole succedent formula, use G2i with Cut as in the proposition, and name N2i in the induction hypothesis.

issues.finding: The displayed rule label is right weakening even though the premise-to-conclusion step adds A on the left and is introduced as left weakening.

issues.location: left-contraction case after the induction hypothesis
issues.finding: The prose renames labelled assumptions and checks discharge in pi_1, a G2i source derivation with no N2 labels, instead of in the translated N2i proof delta_1.
issues.proposed_resolution: Apply the label replacement and side-condition check to delta_1 only.

issues.finding: The right rule reverses the construction direction, saying delta_1 is delta plus an inference. The left rule then relabels source pi_1 instead of translated proof delta_1.
issues.proposed_resolution: Extend delta_1 by implication introduction to obtain delta, and relabel delta_1 before combining translated proofs.

issues.finding: The right rule gives the second translated premise conclusion A instead of B and relabels source pi_2 instead of translated delta_2. The left rule reverses the statement that delta_1 may serve as delta in the unused-assumption case.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use B for delta_2's conclusion, relabel delta_2, and take delta to be delta_1 when the extra left assumption is unused.
